name: Transfer-function restoration recovery
hypothesis: After independently confirmed restoration and new full-route simulations, buy a demand-backed recovery range break.
spec: Setup: A documented operational problem may temporarily prevent demand. Entry: After independently confirmed restoration and new full-route simulations, buy a demand-backed recovery range break. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on renewed transfer failure or range invalidation. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs operational status feeds (transfers, routers, pools) with timestamps
